login.title: Sign in
login.policy: Sign in with an active provider. New accounts are ordinary users. Existing local administrators retain their role only after explicit password-confirmed linking at Account security.
login.empty: No SSO providers are active. Contact your platform administrator.
login.diagnostic: Diagnostic reference to share with your administrator:

errors.login_failed: Sign-in failed or expired. Try again; contact your administrator if the problem persists.
errors.email_collision: This email already belongs to an existing account. Accounts are never automatically linked by email. Local administrators can sign in locally and explicitly link at Account security.
errors.request_failed: Unable to load sign-in providers. Check your connection and reload.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
